title: Reporting Analyst, Workday Reporting
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

The People & Purpose Reporting Services Analyst will be a key member of the People Operations team, providing Workday Reporting support for all employees Join our People & Purpose Reporting Services team, part of People Operations, where we help every employee and manager across Workday get the data they need. We work side-by-side with our People & Purpose Centers of Excellence — Recruiting, Talent Experience, Total Rewards, HR Partners, Learning, Compliance, Belonging and Diversity, and Global Mobility — to close gaps in data and build reports that help our leaders make informed, real-time decisions. We also build self-service tools so our partners can find answers faster on their own. If you enjoy connecting the dots across many parts of HR and turning complex data into something people can act on, you'll feel right at home here.

**About the Role**

As a **Reporting Analyst** , you will be the person people turn to when they need HR data they can rely on, whether that's building a new report, updating an existing one, or digging into a one-off question. You will own high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests from start to finish, helping requesters shape raw data into a clear story they can bring to their own audience. This role touches nearly every area of HR, including recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers, so you will build broad knowledge of how HR data connects across the business. You will also look for ways to make reporting simpler and more enjoyable for everyone who relies on it.
  
In this role, you will:

* Respond to HR data requests spanning recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers
* Be responsible for audits requested by any team across the business, ensuring the underlying data is accurate, complete, and compliant
* Build new reports and update or troubleshoot existing ones in Workday
* Provide attentive, high-touch support for high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests, helping requesters interpret and present their data
* Apply strong data security, accuracy, governance, and standardization practices to every report you deliver
* Prioritize and manage a high volume of requests with competing deadlines
* Create self-service resources that help HR partners find answers faster on their own

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in HR reporting, analytics, or a related data role
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday Reporting (Workday HCM experience is a plus)

**Other Qualifications**

* Able to turn complex HR data into a clear story that helps business leaders make decisions
* Skilled at cleaning, organizing, and combining data from multiple HR systems, with strong attention to data security, accuracy, and governance
* Broad knowledge of HR functions and terminology across areas such as recruiting, total rewards, learning, and compliance
* Attentive and responsive when supporting internal customers, even under tight deadlines
Organized and able to juggle multiple requests and deadlines in a high-volume environment  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.

  

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

  

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible.

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.

title: Service Desk Analyst – APAC
description:

It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

As a **Service Desk Analyst**, you'll power the business by delivering fast, reliable IT support through phone, Microsoft Teams, email, and ServiceNow. You'll take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving hardware, software, account access, and mobile device issues, partnering with Desktop Support, global IT teams, and external vendors to drive solutions when escalation is needed.

* Log, categorize, prioritize and track all incidents and service requests in ServiceNow, and monitor the queue so tickets are resolved and closed within SLA with clear troubleshooting and resolution notes.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software and connectivity issues remotely using remote support tools, and provide walk-up support at the India office in partnership with local Desktop Support.

* Manage user accounts, group memberships and password resets in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and self-service password reset support.

**Who You Are:**

Prefer a Bachelor's Degree in the field of

* - Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* Flexible to work 6:30 AM to 3:30 PM IST, Monday through Friday, ensuring seamless support coverage across multiple time zones and maintaining service availability during designated support hours.
* Additional Experience Desired: Minimum 1 year of experience in an IT help desk role using a ticketing system
* Additional Experience Desired: Between 1-3 years of experience in supporting users in multiple countries
* Computer Skills Desired: Windows and Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment. Active Directory and ITIL-based processes (incident, request, and problem management), ServiceNow ITSM
* Preferred Certifications: CompTIA A+, ITIL 4 Foundation, and/or Microsoft certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate) preferred
* Additional Knowledge or Skills to be Successful in this role: Fluent in English and Hindi, both written and spoken

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Network Security Engineer

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium's mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
Technology is core to the health and growth of our business. The firm's active, multi-manager business model demands flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems, including the development of the next generation of analytical and trading capabilities. Millennium's Information Security team protects the firm's people, data, and technology across a complex, fast-moving global trading environment, partnering closely with technology, trading, and business stakeholders to embed security into every aspect of our global operations. As the firm accelerates its use of artificial intelligence, the team is equally focused on applying AI in innovative, entrepreneurial ways to strengthen our own defenses. Within that organization, the Network Security team designs and defends the network infrastructure connecting Millennium's global offices, data centers, and cloud environments, spanning perimeter controls such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, NDR, NAC, proxies, email security, and DNS security, as well as the detection and automation stack behind them, including the security data lake, logging pipelines, and SOAR automations. This is a growing organization that combines deep technical expertise with pragmatic risk management to keep pace with the speed and scale of the firm's business.

**What You'll Do**  

* Design, implement, and maintain network security controls, including firewalls, segmentation, secure remote access, intrusion detection and prevention, network detection and response, and network access control, and support secure network architecture for new offices, data centers, and cloud connectivity.
* Build and maintain the logging pipelines and security data lake that power detection across the environment.
* Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, procedures, and standards across network security, email security, DNS security, and the security data lake.
* Strengthen perimeter security through automation, improved monitoring, vulnerability identification, and actionable alerting and reporting.
* Monitor, manage, and analyze security logs, alerts, and events across multiple systems to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and suspicious activity, and tune network infrastructure to reduce risk while minimizing business disruption.
* Apply AI to the team's own work, accelerating investigation, automation, detection engineering, and reporting, and help secure the firm's use of AI models, tools, and frameworks.
* Provide security engineering and consulting support to Security Operations and the wider Information Security organization, and partner with stakeholders across Technology, Trading, Legal, Internal Audit, and Compliance to support and enforce security policies and controls.
* Conduct system audits and vulnerability assessments, manage remediation efforts and findings from audits, penetration tests, and process reviews, participate in incident response for network-related events, and use threat intelligence to sharpen detection, defense, and response.

**What You Bring**  

* 5+ years of hands-on network security experience, ideally within financial services, hedge funds or other buy-side firms, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands-on experience administering enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls, VPN, proxies, intrusion detection and prevention, network detection and response, and network access control, with a practical understanding of proxy engineering concepts.
* Proven experience as a security engineer with hands-on expertise in logging pipelines, data lakes, or SIEM platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Sentinel, or S3/Athena, plus SOAR automation; experience with breach and attack simulation tooling is a plus.
* Hands-on AI experience, both using AI tooling in day-to-day security work and securing the use, deployment, and governance of AI models, tools, and frameworks.
* Strong command of core networking and infrastructure concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, segmentation, DNS, Wi-Fi, and virtualization, along with email and DNS security controls and packet capture and network analysis tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or ngrep.
* Experience securing hybrid on-premises and cloud network architectures, with working knowledge of AWS, GCP, or Azure and proficiency across Windows, Linux, macOS, and container environments such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Scripting or development skills in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages, with the ability to troubleshoot complex network and security issues under time pressure, operate independently in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment, and communicate clearly with both deeply technical teams and senior executive stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity/Information Security, or a related field, or commensurate work experience; certifications such as CISSP, GCIA, CISM, CCNP Security, Palo Alto PCNSE, or Fortinet NSE are valued.

title: Smart Factory IoT Security Engineer
description:
**Your role**

  

As Smart Factory Security Engineer, you own the security of every solution onboarded into VTBA's Smart Factory and Industry 4.0 landscape. You act as the security gatekeeper and technical authority for new OT/IIoT systems, connected production equipment, and digital manufacturing solutions from the moment they are evaluated until they are fully integrated and running in production. You embed security by design into every onboarding: assessing risk, defining and enforcing hardening and segmentation requirements, validating secure architectures, and ensuring new systems comply with IEC 62443, NIS2, and internal security policy before and after go-live. You maintain an up-to-date OT/IIoT security posture and asset inventory (CMDB), act as the first point of contact for the business on security matters, and ensure that production processes are never compromised by unsecured or unmanaged systems.You support M&A and integration due diligence from a security standpoint, securing previously unregistered or newly acquired systems, and you collaborate closely with IT, network, production, and external integration partners to guarantee a seamless and secure Industry 4.0 rollout. In case of a security incident or outage tied to onboarded solutions, you drive root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive measures.

* Develop the Smart Factory cybersecurity strategy aligned with business and security objectives.
* Design secure architectures for manufacturing systems, Industrial IoT (IIoT), MES, and OT networks
* Own the security review and validation of all new OT/IIoT solutions being onboarded onto Smart Factory / production networks, from design through go-live.
* Define and enforce security-by-design requirements (segmentation, hardening, access control, secure remote access) for new production lines, machines, and digital solutions.
* Be the first point of contact and internal security consultant for production engineers, IT teams, and solution vendors during onboarding projects.
* Maintain a secure and stable OT/IIoT environment for VTBA, including an accurate, continuously updated OT security asset inventory (CMDB).
* Support Smart Factory projects involving IoT, AI, cloud connectivity, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing platforms.
* Define and maintain OT asset inventories, security baselines, and lifecycle management processes.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and penetration testing of industrial systems.
* Act as the security contact for external production and integration partners, reviewing and validating the security quality of their work before systems connect to company networks.
* Drive compliance with IEC 62443, NIS2, ANSSI-aligned practices, and internal IT/OT security regulations across all onboarded solutions.
* Support M&A and acquisition due diligence, assessing and securing newly acquired or previously unregistered OT/IIoT systems.
* Perform regular on-call duty for security-related escalations on onboarded solutions

  

**To succeed you will need:**

  

* 2+ years' experience securing OT/IIoT or Industry 4.0 environments
* Solid knowledge of IEC 62443 and familiarity with NIS2 and other relevant OT/ICS cybersecurity frameworks.
* Strong understanding of network segmentation, secure remote access, and hardening practices for industrial and IIoT systems.
* Customer Service Skills (interaction with end users and solution vendors).
* ITIL process knowledge.
* Understanding of reporting & data visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI and Excel.
* Advanced troubleshooting experience in OT/IIoT environments, including security log analysis (firewall, OT Defender, machine logs).
* Analytical Skills-able to conduct security risk assessments and analyze log files to identify vulnerabilities and operational limitations.
* Reporting Skills-able to summarize and present periodic security reports and recommend improvements to onboarding procedures.
* Planning Skills-able to define security requirements and roadmaps for new solutions and production facilities.
* Excellent communication skills in English-written and verbal.
* Self-organized and persistent in a polite way to obtain missing information from colleagues, business, and vendors.
* Willing to undertake national and international business travel to support the secure rollout of new OT/IIoT solutions.

  

**In return, we offer you**

  

We offer you a modern and flexible work in a company that manufactures state-of-the-art and innovative vacuum products and systems. You will be part of a young and international team and will have the opportunity to support the latest technologies. This guarantees training and enables you to develop further. We work in flat structures and all IT colleagues are in direct contact with the internal customers to understand their technical needs and support them in technology. Thus, in addition to the technical network knowledge, you will also gain a deep insight into the internal processes and projects of our company.

**What you'll do:** **Senior Incident Response Analyst** in the **Enterprise** will…

* Lead end-to-end investigations for complex incidents: validate alert context, determine scope, assess impact, and build an audit-ready timeline and evidence trail.
* Apply a forensic mindset to every investigation: preserve volatile and non-volatile evidence early, maintain chain of custody, and ensure findings are reproducible and can withstand legal, regulatory, or client scrutiny.
* Act as an escalation point for high-priority security events and ambiguous cases; guide triage-to-investigation handoffs and ensure defensible conclusions.
* Perform endpoint, memory, and cloud forensic triage (e.g., disk and memory captures, system artifacts, cloud audit logs) to reconstruct attacker activity and root cause; support third-party forensic partners on high-severity cases and validate their findings.
* Coordinate containment, eradication, and recovery actions with system owners and partner teams; verify remediation completion and document closure rationale.
* Partner with the Senior Incident Response Lead on incident command execution, including stakeholder communications cadence, task tracking, and post-incident action closure.
* Leverage the Incident Response Specialist for deep technical analysis and quality reviews; incorporate feedback into investigation standards and templates.
* Maintain and improve incident response playbooks, checklists, and communication templates based on lessons learned and recurring incident patterns.
* Contribute to readiness exercises (tabletops/purple-team activities) and ensure outcomes translate into concrete corrective actions.
* Create incident metrics and reporting inputs (e.g., response timeliness, containment effectiveness, recurring root causes) to support operational governance.
* Use automation as a mindset: identify repeatable steps in investigations suitable for automation or AI assistance (summaries, enrichment notes, evidence packaging) and validate outputs against source artifacts before operational use.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5 years of experience in security operations with hands-on incident response experience, including ownership of complex investigations.

description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19196****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

**Vulnerability Management Analyst - Semiconductor IP**

**We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are:**

You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams when the topic is risk. You listen first, explain complex findings in clear language, and own your conclusions. You help people understand what a vulnerability means for their work and what they should do next.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You stay focused on timely action, challenge unclear choices in a respectful way, and keep looking for better ways to reduce risk. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving guidance that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Analyze vulnerabilities affecting semiconductor IP products, firmware, and related interfaces, and determine residual risk with clear assumptions.
* Prioritize findings so product teams can act in a timely way: severity, exploitability, affected assets, and recommended mitigations.
* Work with design, verification, firmware, and product teams to explain vulnerabilities, walk through impact, and agree how the team will mitigate.
* Advise those teams on practical mitigations, compensating controls, and verification or test evidence that shows the risk is reduced.
* Work in semiconductor IP development and associated test flows, using the tools those teams use to design, verify, and test IP, so analysis matches how the product is actually built.
* Build and maintain your own analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting tools, including in Python, when existing tools are not enough. Scripts and tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Track open risk through the cybersecurity lifecycle, from intake through analysis, treatment, verification, and internal release decisions, and keep status current.
* Facilitate working sessions so similar IP classes get consistent analysis, risk language, and mitigation guidance.
* Look for new and practical ways to detect, assess, and mitigate risk, including improved methods, automation, and lessons from prior findings.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research and first drafts without handing off ownership of risk conclusions.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track vulnerability and risk work, keep documentation current, and version work products through review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams vulnerability analysis and risk determinations they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Reduce time-to-mitigation by explaining findings clearly and agreeing practical next steps with the teams that own the product.
* Leave mitigation and test guidance that design, verification, and firmware teams can execute.
* Keep residual risk visible and current so internal release and treatment decisions are based on evidence, not stale status.
* Improve consistency of vulnerability handling and risk language across similar IP classes.
* Raise the quality of risk reduction over time by bringing new methods, better mitigations, and fit-for-purpose tools into the workflow.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically 3 or more years in vulnerability management, product cybersecurity, embedded security, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on vulnerability analysis and risk determination can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Strong practical experience in vulnerability analysis on real products, not only scanning or training exercises.
* Ability to determine risk: severity, exploitability, affected assets, likelihood, impact, and residual risk after proposed mitigations.
* Ability to explain vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations to engineering teams so they can act in a timelyway.
* Working familiarity with semiconductor IP development and associated testing, including the tools used to design, verify, and test IP. Specific commercial tool names are not required.
* Ability to write and maintain your own tools, including in Python, for analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting when existing tools are not enough. This is not a software-engineering role. Tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Experience working with incomplete information and stating assumptions when the end-system is not fully known.
Experience* ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, design, implementation, verification, and internal release, including tracking open risk to closure.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems enough to reason about hardware-rooted and firmware vulnerabilities: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, interfaces, registers, boot and debug, and interconnects.
* Experience delivering analysis inside product-team cadence, including re-prioritizing when new findings or design changes arrive.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.

* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of common vulnerability scoring and handling practice (for example CVSS) is helpful, as is ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard, digital design or verification background (including RTL), semiconductor IP product experience, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design and product teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is about risk.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a scanner, a score, a tool, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers can understand a vulnerability and how to mitigate it without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You drive timely action. You keep risk visible until it is treated or accepted with a clear rationale.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend mitigations teams can actually adopt.
* You keep learning. You look for new and practical ways to assess and reduce risk, not only the methods you already know.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as findings and designs change.

**The Team You’ll Be** **A** **Part Of:**

You will join the CySec Vulnerability Management Team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. You work with IP product teams in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, firmware, and verification engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to analyze vulnerabilities, determine risk, and agree mitigations through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by internal product and engineering teams.

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

Docusign is seeking a Cyber Threat Intelligence Engineer to join our Threat Intelligence team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain infrastructure, tools, and capabilities that enables the Threat Intelligence team to perform threat intelligence analysis and dissemination. You will create tools, automations, dashboards, data pipelines, and integrations that enable fast, scalable, and centralized access to threat intelligence data. The ideal candidate will have strong engineering skills and past experience in security operations.

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager of the Threat Intelligence team.

  



**Responsibility**


* Architect, construct, and maintain robust infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing cyber threat intelligence data
* Implement engineering best practices to maximize data quality and operational visibility for threat analysis
* Develop and deploy scalable automation workflows to streamline threat intelligence operations
* Collaborate with analysts to translate operational requirements into high\-performing, reliable technical solutions
* Produce technical documentation, interactive dashboards, and key metrics to measure system performance and business impact

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**

* 3\+ years of proven experience in cyber threat intelligence engineering, incident response, security automation, or data engineering
* Hands\-on experience leveraging Generative AI for security operations, including prompt definition, model benchmarking, and integrating scalable AI solutions into intelligence workflows
* Demonstrated ability to configure, deploy, and maintain threat intelligence platforms (TIPs) and integrate structured threat data into enterprise security tools
* Proficiency in creating and managing interactive Python notebooks (e.g., Jupyter, Marimo), configuring data connections, building reusable workflows, and documenting analytical processes
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  

**Preferred**

* Experience designing and operating cloud\-based data platforms, automation services, and infrastructure\-as\-code in AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Proficiency with Git\-based development practices, including branching, pull requests, code review, CI/CD, and automated testing
* Experience integrating threat intelligence platforms with enterprise security tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and case\-management systems
* Knowledge of threat intelligence standards and data technologies, including STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT\&CK, Python, SQL, APIs, and relational, graph, or search databases
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly
